directions: Exact geometric Sun and Earth-center azimuths from pinned DE421; observer 0.5 m above measured surface
baseline: 5 m radial step from 5 to 1000 m; 80 m step to 16 km; 130 logarithmic samples to 220 km
refinement: Half the near/regional steps, double far sample count; same DEM and ray azimuth
interpretation: A limited sampled numerical refinement check. Not an absolute accuracy claim, global bound, independent ephemeris validation, or observed-shadow validation.
